reason: Compile-time proof that a create row omitting a NOT NULL column without a default fails to typecheck; the pragma goes unused, and the build fails, if that looseness ever returns.

Compile-time proof that only a declared setting can be changed: a key the settings catalog does not hold must fail to typecheck, and the pragma goes unused, failing the build, if the catalog ever stops being the whole set.
Compile-time proof that the send seam refuses a bare string: only the prompt catalog mints what an Agent may hear, and the pragma goes unused, failing the build, if that guarantee is ever relaxed.

Compile-time proof of the two guarantees the journal kit's types carry: a command's rows handle is read-only, and a feature's every fact has exactly one materializer. Both pragmas go unused, and the build fails, if either guarantee is ever relaxed.
